notes.subject: han wara
notes.rationale: נחלה i min inheritance — graun o samting papa i givim; 'han wara' em i Tok Pisin pasin bilong tokim olsem.

notes.subject: לבז ולמשסה
notes.rationale: Tupela tok bilong planda klostu wankain, wantaim repitisen bilong אויביהם tupela taim — paton bilong Hibru, Tok Pisin i holim wantaim tupela tok.

translation: Na bai mi lusim ⟨את⟩ ol manmeri i stap liklik yet bilong han wara bilong mi, na bai mi givim ol long han bilong ol birua bilong ol; na bai ol i kamap planda na olgeta samting bilong tekewe long olgeta birua bilong ol.
